concept: A wanderer who watches a quarrel long enough to know every armed hand in it, ends it with one volley that strips the weapons and kills no one, and is gone before the third day ends.

interaction.description: Time spent watching a dispute teaches the user which hands hold weapons and in what order they will move; one fast volley then disables every weapon in a single breath, the vow keeps every shot non-lethal, and the three-day rule forces the user to leave before the place can adapt.

emergent_ability.name: Quiet Volley
emergent_ability.description: After watching a dispute long enough to read who holds what and how each will move, the user ends it with one fast, precise volley that strips every weapon from every armed hand without killing anyone.
limitations: Needs watching first: without time spent observing a dispute, the volley cannot be aimed and does not fire.
It only reaches weapons held in a hand; it cannot stop a threat that is not held, such as gas, fire or a locked room.
Past a handful of armed targets, one volley cannot disable them all and is not attempted.
The vow bounds it: no setting is lethal, so it cannot end a fight that only a lethal shot would end.
The three-day rule applies: the user must leave before the third day ends, so a dispute that outlasts the stay is left unresolved.
emergent_ability.activation: Sustained observation of a dispute, with the user not yet committed to either side.

trait_outcomes.result_text: Carried as a hard bound on every stay: the ability's clock runs out when the stay does.
Carried: watching comes first, and the ability never starts a fight.
Carried: speed is what lets one volley cover many hands.

trait_outcomes.reason: A general road skill the authored rule does not use.
A separate being, not a trait; the rule needs no companion.

trait_outcomes.result_text: Carried: no allies and no resources beyond what the user can carry.

trait_outcomes.reason: Its output cannot be tuned to a volley of disabling shots; this design uses only handgun precision.
The limit belongs to the arm, which is not carried.

trait_outcomes.result_text: Carried as a hard bound: no setting of the volley is lethal.
Precision in disabling shots becomes the aimed, simultaneous disabling of every armed hand.

trait_outcomes.reason: Species physiology is not a mechanic this ability uses.
A reputation is a narrative role, not a transferable mechanic.
